title: Docker log verification failed when checking if agent found test API details
description: The verification system attempted to check docker logs to confirm the agent successfully accessed API details, but the check failed with an error. This prevented ground truth verification of task completion despite the agent believing it succeeded.
symptoms: Agent narration claims Goal 3 complete after finding test API, but verification FAILED due to docker log error accessing API details
Discrepancy between agent's perceived success and ground truth
root_cause_hint: Docker container logs may not be accessible to the verification harness, or the expected log pattern is not being generated by the test API container
evidence: [bug] task=find-credential | Agent narration claims Goal 3 complete after finding test API, but verification FAILED due to docker log error accessing API details. Discrepancy between agent's perceived success and ground truth.

title: Docker log verification failed when checking if test API received proxied request
description: The verification system could not confirm via docker logs that the test API actually received the proxied request, even though the agent received a successful response and execution records show success.
symptoms: Agent narration claims successful proxied request, but verification shows FAILED check for test API receiving the request (docker log error)
Execution record exists and shows success, but end-to-end verification incomplete
root_cause_hint: Docker container logs for the test API are not accessible to the verification harness, or log patterns expected by verification are not being generated
evidence: [bug] task=make-proxied-request | Agent narration claims successful proxied request, but verification shows FAILED check for test API receiving the request (docker log error). Execution record exists and shows success, but end-to-end verification incomplete.

title: jq command not available in agent environment
description: The agent attempted to use jq for JSON parsing but the command was not found in the environment. This is a minor issue as the agent was able to complete tasks without it, but it may be a useful tool for agents to have available.
symptoms: Exit code 127: /bin/bash: line 1: jq: command not found
Agent attempted to use jq for JSON parsing but command not found in environment (exit 127)
root_cause_hint: jq package not installed in the agent's execution environment container/image
evidence: Exit code 127: /bin/bash: line 1: jq: command not found
[misc] task=make-proxied-request | Agent attempted to use jq for JSON parsing but command not found in environment (exit 127).
